answer: Cost first: one audit slot per epoch is cheaper to run than one fake identity. A random sample of identities is re-queued to a second panel, which recomputes the receipt and compares it with the whisper of the first panel. Mismatch voids the answer and vests the reward against future work. A farm spanning a nebula of addresses pays the sample rate on every clone and still loses the vested share. The jade seal of a passing audit is worth only what the second panel charges.
